JOB DESCRIPTION 







 
 Software Engineer – Application Technology (ServiceNow - CMDB)   
 

 The Big Picture   
 

 Sysco LABS is the Global In-House Center of Sysco Corporation (NYSE: SYY), the world’s largest foodservice company. Sysco ranks 56th in the Fortune 500 list and is the global leader in the trillion-dollar foodservice industry .     
 

 Sysco employs over 75,000 associates, has 337 smart distribution facilities worldwide and over 14,000 IoT-enabled trucks serving 730,000 customer locations. For fiscal year 2025 that ended June 29, 2025, the company generated sales of more than $81.4 billion .     
 

 Sysco LABS Sri Lanka delivers the technology that powers Sysco’s end-to-end operations . Sysco LABS’ enterprise technology is present in the end-to-end foodservice journey, enabling the sourcing of food products, merchandising, storage and warehouse operations, order placement and pricing algorithms, the delivery of food and supplies to Sysco’s global network and the in-restaurant dining experience of the end-customer.   

   

 The Opportunity   

   

 We are looking for a dedicated ServiceNow Developer with a strong emphasis on CMDB and Discovery to help us implement, improve, and ensure the operational stability of our Configuration Management Database and associated discovery/integration procedures. The ideal candidate will have practical experience setting up ServiceNow Discovery, handling CI data, and conforming to the Common Service Data Model (CSDM) to guarantee reliable, accurate , and useful data on the platform.   

   

 Responsibilities:   

   

 Perform ing day-to-day administration and maintenance of the ServiceNow platform, with a focus on supporting CMDB and Discovery activities   

 
 Identify ing and resolv ing discrepancies or issues related to CMDB data, integration errors, and CI relationships   

 
 Develop ing reports, dashboards, and KPIs to monitor CMDB health and provide insights for decision-making   

 
 Conduct ing regular audits, reconciliation activities, and data integrity checks to maintain a healthy CMDB   

 
 Integrat ing with external data sources using Integration Hub, REST/SOAP APIs, or import ing sets to enrich CI data   

 
 Collaborat ing with stakeholders to define discovery schedules, scopes, and CI attributes relevant to business needs   

 
   

 Requirements:   


   

 A Bachelor’s D egree in Computer Science , Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field   

 
 2+ years of hands-on ServiceNow development experience, including CMDB and Discovery   

 
 Experience deploying and managing MID Servers, credentials, and discovery probes/patterns   

 
 Experience t roubleshoot ing discovery errors and CI population issues using logs, probes, sensors, and patterns   

 
 A s olid understanding of ITIL principles, especially Configuration Management, and experience applying them in an enterprise CMDB environment   

 
 Proficien cy in designing CI relationships, dependency mappings, and data normalization strategies   

 
 Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills with strong attention to detail   

 
 Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to work collaboratively across teams   

 
   

   

 Benefits:   

 US dollar-linked compensation    

 
 Performance-based annual bonus    

 
 Performance rewards and recognition    

 
 Agile Benefits - special allowances for Health, Wellness & Academic purposes    

 
 Paid birthday leave   

 
 Team engagement allowance    

 
 Comprehensive Health & Life Insurance Cover - extendable to parents and in-laws    

 
 Overseas travel opportunities and exposure to client environments    

 

 Hybrid work arrangement    

 
   

 Sysco LABS is an Equal Opportunity Employer
